author: Michael Larabel
description: The Nouveau Linux kernel graphics driver for open-source NVIDIA driver support has new patches posted for enabling HDMI Deep Color support...
title: Open-Source NVIDIA "Nouveau" Driver Sees Patches For HDMI Deep Color Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last week I ran some benchmarks showing performance gains for AMD Ryzen AI Max+ "Strix Halo" on Ubuntu 26.10. Then shortly after that testing on its daily state, which used the Linux 7.2 kernel, Canonical switched to Linux 7.3 as the Ubuntu 26.10 kernel. Here are some Linux 7.2 vs. Linux 7.3 benchmarks for the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 "Strix Halo" with the Framework Desktop...
title: Linux 7.2 vs. Linux 7.3 Shows A Few Improvements With AMD Strix Halo

author: Michael Larabel
description: In 2024 Canonical generated nearly $300M USD in revenue for this company behind Ubuntu Linux and other services and software solutions. For 2025, they not only broke $300M but well exceeded it with $345M in revenue...
title: Ubuntu Linux Maker Canonical Achieved $345M USD In Revenue For 2025

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new proposal being discussed is introducing a Linux user-space API to be able to specify frame rate targets for Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) handling on the Linux desktop...
title: Variable Refresh Rate "VRR" Target Limiter Proposed For Linux Graphics Drivers

author: Michael Larabel
description: SPEC back in May 2025 introduced SPECViewPerf 15 as the newest major release of this industry-standard workstation graphics benchmark. Sadly, the Linux support once again fell behind with SPECViewPerf 15 only debuting on Microsoft Windows. Today though Linux has caught up with SPEC releasing a Linux-native build of SPECViewPerf 15.0.1...
title: SPEC Releases SPECviewperf 15.0.1 For Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: Systemd 262 made it out today as the newest feature update to this Linux init system and service manager. As with most systemd releases, it's heavy on new features and functionality...
title: systemd 262 Released With AI/LLM Canary For Unreviewed Code, LUO Integration

author: Michael Larabel
description: The open-source YSERVER project as a modern X11 sever written in the Rust programming language with the help of Claude Code is out today with a new feature release. Most notable for this AI Rust X11 server is X Display Manager Control Protocol (XDMCP) support for multi-user shared desktops...
title: Vibe Coded YSERVER Adds XDMCP Support For Multi-User Shared Desktops

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Omarchy project announced today that Alibaba Cloud will be contributing a total of three million USD to their foundation for helping development of this Linux distribution and working to make it an "ideal agentic operating system"...
title: Alibaba Contributing $3M USD To Omarchy To Work On Making "Ideal" Agentic OS

author: Michael Larabel
description: Sent out today was a new HID subsystem pull request of fixes for the week to the Linux 7.3 kernel. Besides some conventional bug fixes are also supporting some additional devices via quirks and new IDs...
title: Linux 7.3 Adding Logitech G502 X Lightspeed USB Support, ELECOM M-XT4DRBK

author: Michael Larabel

title: Promotion Reminder For Ad-Free Viewing, Multi-Page Articles On A Single Page

author: Michael Larabel
description: Later this week it looks like the latest round of Cache Aware Scheduling fixes will be merged for enhancing this kernel scheduler functionality  for grouping related tasks together on CPU cores that share the same last level cache (LLC). Cache Aware Scheduling can lead to better cache locality and lower latency by avoiding the costs of potential cache bouncing -- that is when bugs don't get in the way...
title: Cache Aware Scheduling Fixes Queued For Submission To Linux 7.3, Backporting To 7.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: ZLUDA as the open-source project working on CUDA for non-NVIDIA GPUs like AMD Radeon graphics cards now has implemented support for some of NVIDIA's core cuFFT APIs...
title: ZLUDA Now Implements Some NVIDIA cuFFT APIs With hipFFT
